`benmore create-app <name> [--json]` creates a deployed app (the `create_app` tool). `--json` prints the tool's JSON answer unchanged; without it the CLI prints the new subdomain and URL as text. Run in a folder that holds app.yaml or schema.prisma and no .benmore/app marker, it creates the app without the starter's demo files and links the folder to it, so the next `benmore deploy` ships the local files.
`benmore delete <app> --confirm` removes the app (api(at:"recovery") delete_app). `-y` is accepted in place of `--confirm`; without either the command refuses (exit 1) and sends nothing.
`benmore sync [--force]` pulls every app in the account's app list into the Benmore workspace (api(at:"sync-status") workspace_sync).

`benmore tool <name> [key=val ...] [--args-json '<json>'] [--env dev|prod]` calls any platform MCP tool by name and prints its text answer; an image in the answer (a browser_check screenshot) is saved to a temporary file whose path is printed. `true`, `false`, `null`, whole numbers and values that parse as a JSON array or object are sent typed, everything else as a string; `--args-json` supplies the arguments as one JSON object. `--env` (else the `benmore use` pin) is sent as the tool's `env` argument unless an `env=` argument names one. A tool error prints the tool's message on stderr and exits 1.
